body:
🟡 **Test gap** | Minor

**Descending and due_at sorting untested.** The PR promises sorting by created, issued or due date, ascending or descending, with missing dates last. The test only covers `sort=issued_at` ascending and `created_at` descending. It never checks `order=desc` with NULLs (drafts), and it never uses `sort=due_at`. Both go through `NULLS LAST`. Add `sort=issued_at&order=desc` expecting the draft last, and a `due_at` case with one invoice created with `due_at`.

<details><summary>🤖 Fix with AI</summary>

```text
Fix this code review finding in GauravChopada/ledgerline, pull request 6. The line number is from commit a29ef76; if the file has changed since, find the same code.

[Minor · missing test] Descending and due_at sorting untested — test/exports.test.ts:77
The PR promises sorting by created, issued or due date, ascending or descending, with missing dates last. The test only covers `sort=issued_at` ascending and `created_at` descending. It never checks `order=desc` with NULLs (drafts), and it never uses `sort=due_at`. Both go through `NULLS LAST`. Add `sort=issued_at&order=desc` expecting the draft last, and a `due_at` case with one invoice created with `due_at`.

Read the code at the location first and confirm the problem. Make the smallest change that fixes it, without changing unrelated code or existing behaviour. Add or update a test that would have caught it. If you think it is not a real problem, say why instead of changing the code.
```
